syntactic:
CREATE PROCEDURE soccerGameSeries()
BEGIN
    SELECT CASE
        WHEN wins > 0 THEN 1
        WHEN wins < 0 THEN 2
        ELSE CASE
            WHEN goaldiff > 0 THEN 1
            WHEN goaldiff < 0 THEN 2
            ELSE CASE
                WHEN goalsaway > 0 THEN 1
                WHEN goalsaway < 0 THEN 2
                ELSE 0
            END
    END AS winner FROM
    (SELECT SUM(wins) as wins,
           SUM(goaldiff) as goaldiff,
           SUM(goalsaway) as goalsaway
        FROM (SELECT match_id,
        IF(first_team_score = second_team_score, 0, IF(first_team_score > second_team_score, 1, -1)) AS wins,
        first_team_score - second_team_score AS goaldiff,
        IF(match_host=2, first_team_score, -second_team_score) AS goalsaway
        FORM scores) dt) dd;
END
semantic:
CREATE PROCEDURE soccerGameSeries()
BEGIN
    SELECT CASE
        WHEN wins > 0 THEN 1
        WHEN wins < 0 THEN 2
        ELSE CASE
            WHEN goaldiff > 0 THEN 1
            WHEN goaldiff < 0 THEN 2
            ELSE CASE
                WHEN goalsaway > 0 THEN 1
                WHEN goalsaway < 0 THEN 2
                ELSE 0
            END
        END
    END AS winner FROM
    (SELECT SUM(wins) as wins,
           SUM(goaldiff) as goaldiff,
           SUM(goalsaway) as goalsaway
        FROM (SELECT game_id,
        IF(team1_goals = team2_goals, 0, IF(team1_goals > team2_goals, 1, -1)) AS wins,
        team1_goals - team2_goals AS goaldiff,
        IF(host_team=2, team1_goals, -team2_goals) AS goalsaway
        FROM match_results) dt) dd;
END
conceptual:

BEGIN

        WHEN SUM(first_team_score) > SUM(second_team_score) THEN 1
        WHEN SUM(first_team_score) < SUM(second_team_score) THEN 2
        ELSE 0
    END AS winner
    FROM scores;
END

CREATE PROCEDURE bugsInComponent()
BEGIN
    SELECT bug_title, component_title, bugs_in_component FORM (SELECT c.id AS comp_id, b.num AS bug_id, b.title AS bug_title, c.title AS component_title, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BugComponent bc2 JOIN Component c2 ON bc2.component_id = c2.id GROUP BY c2.id HAVIN c2.id = c.id) AS bugs_in_component, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM
    BugComponent bc3 GROUP BY bug_num HAVING bc3.bug_num = b.num AS num_of_bugs
    FROM Bug b JOIN BugComponent bc ON b.num = bc.bug_num

    ORDER BY bugs_in_component DESC, t.comp_id, t.bug_id;

semantic:
CREATE PROCEDURE bugsInComponent()
BEGIN
    SELECT bug_title, component_title, bugs_in_component FROM (SELECT c.comp_id AS comp_id, b.issue_id AS bug_id, b.bug_name AS bug_title, c.comp_name AS component_title, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IssueMapping bc2 JOIN SystemModule c2 ON bc2.module_id = c2.comp_id GROUP BY c2.comp_id HAVING c2.comp_id = c.comp_id) AS bugs_in_component, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM
    IssueMapping bc3 GROUP BY issue_num HAVING bc3.issue_num = b.issue_id) AS num_of_bugs
    FROM SystemBug b JOIN IssueMapping bc ON b.issue_id = bc.issue_num
    JOIN SystemModule c ON c.comp_id = bc.module_id) t
    WHERE t.num_of_bugs > 1
    ORDER BY bugs_in_component DESC, t.comp_id, t.bug_id;
END
conceptual:
CREATE PROCEDURE bugsInComponent()
BEGIN
    SELECT b.title AS bug_title, c.title AS component_title, COUNT(*) AS bugs_in_component
    FROM Bug b JOIN BugComponent bc ON b.num = bc.bug_num
    JOIN Component c ON c.id = bc.component_id
    GROUP BY c.id, b.num
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1
    ORDER BY bugs_in_component ASC, c.id DESC;
END
